results.pair_summary: Doc A defines the core IR data structure, immutability invariants, and abstract Stream type definition. Doc B specifies the concrete runtime implementation of the IR buffer (ir-stream), detailing lifecycle management, memory models, threading constraints, and operational APIs.
results.integration_rationale: Doc A establishes the immutable schema and semantic neutrality of IR objects required for Delta3 Kernel analysis (Phase A: Core Types). Doc B implements the ephemeral, mutable collection mechanism necessary to aggregate these observations during execution without polluting the core type definition with runtime state logic (Phase B: Runtime Infrastructure). Keeping them separate ensures a clean separation between data contracts and execution environment management.
